```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

NAVY <- "#2C4A5E"  # gentle dark blue

# --- Pull top 10 VIMP directly from your Stage 2 RSF fit ---
rsf_fit_v2 <- readRDS("rsf_fit_v2.rds")
vimp2 <- sort(rsf_fit_v2$importance, decreasing = TRUE)

vimp_df <- data.frame(
  metacluster = names(vimp2),
  vimp = as.numeric(vimp2)
) %>%
  mutate(metacluster = str_remove(metacluster, "^abundance_metacluster_leiden_1\\.0_")) %>%
  slice_max(vimp, n = 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(vimp)) %>%
  mutate(metacluster = factor(metacluster, levels = rev(metacluster)))

p <- ggplot(vimp_df, aes(x = vimp, y = metacluster)) +
  geom_col(fill = NAVY, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", vimp)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 3.3, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18)),
    limits = c(0, max(vimp_df$vimp) * 1.18)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "RSF Variable Importance: Top 10 MetaClusters",
    x = "VIMP",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = NAVY, size = 13, hjust = 0),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

p

ggsave(
  "rsf_vimp_stage2_top10.png",
  plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
#### i want a method that incorporates the surivival data
library(randomForestSRC)
library(survival)

# ── 0. Prep data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
prob_mat             <- as.matrix(merged_df[, leiden_cols])
zero_frac            <- colMeans(prob_mat == 0)
leiden_cols_filtered <- names(zero_frac[zero_frac <= 0.99])

rsf_data <- merged_df[, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event", leiden_cols_filtered)]

# ── 1. Stage 1 RSF fit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
rsf_fit <- rfsrc(
  Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ .,
  data       = rsf_data,
  ntree      = 1000,
  splitrule  = "logrank",
  importance = TRUE,
  ntime      = 100,
  seed       = 42
)

cat("Stage 1 OOB C-index:",
    round(1 - tail(rsf_fit$err.rate, 1), 4), "\n")

saveRDS(rsf_fit, "rsf_fit_stage1.rds")
rsf_fit <- readRDS("rsf_fit_stage1.rds")

# ── 2. Stage 1 variable importance + plot ─────────────────────────────────────
vimp <- sort(rsf_fit$importance, decreasing = TRUE)

par(mar = c(4, 10, 3, 1))
barplot(
  rev(vimp[1:15]),
  horiz = TRUE,
  las   = 1,
  col   = "#3288BD",
  main  = "RSF Variable Importance: Top 15 MetaClusters (Stage 1)",
  xlab  = "VIMP"
)

cat("Stage 1 VIMP (top 20):\n")
print(head(vimp, 20))

# Keep only features with VIMP > 0 (positive contribution)
vars_vimp_pos <- names(vimp)[vimp > 0]
cat("Stage 1: variables with VIMP > 0:", length(vars_vimp_pos), "\n")

rsf_data_filtered <- rsf_data[, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event", vars_vimp_pos)]

# ── 3. Stage 2 RSF fit on VIMP>0 vars ────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
rsf_fit_v2 <- rfsrc(
  Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ .,
  data       = rsf_data_filtered,
  ntree      = 1000,
  splitrule  = "logrank",
  importance = TRUE,
  ntime      = 100,
  seed       = 42
)

cat("Stage 2 OOB C-index:",
    round(1 - tail(rsf_fit_v2$err.rate, 1), 4), "\n")

saveRDS(rsf_fit_v2, "rsf_fit_v2.rds")
rsf_fit_v2 <- readRDS("rsf_fit_v2.rds")

# ── 4. Risk scoring from final RSF ────────────────────────────────────────────
# rfsrc silently drops NA outcome rows — align survival_df to model rows
dfs_complete <- !is.na(rsf_data_filtered$dfs_months) &
                !is.na(rsf_data_filtered$dfs_event)

survival_df            <- as.data.frame(rsf_data_filtered[dfs_complete, ])
survival_df$rsf_risk   <- rsf_fit_v2$predicted
survival_df$patient_id <- merged_df$patient_id[which(dfs_complete)]

cat("Rows in survival_df:", nrow(survival_df), "\n")

# ── 5. Stage 2 variable importance + plot + top 15 names ─────────────────────
vimp2 <- sort(rsf_fit_v2$importance, decreasing = TRUE)

par(mar = c(4, 10, 3, 1))
barplot(
  rev(vimp2[1:15]),
  horiz = TRUE,
  las   = 1,
  col   = "#3288BD",
  main  = "RSF Variable Importance: Top 15 MetaClusters (Stage 2)",
  xlab  = "VIMP"
)

cat("Stage 2 VIMP (top 20):\n")
print(head(vimp2, 20))

top_vars <- names(vimp2)[1:15]
cat("Stage 2: top 15 variables retained:\n")
print(top_vars)
```


```{r}
# ── Rebuild rsf_data: drop only on dfs NAs ────────────────────────────────────
survival_complete <- !is.na(merged_df$dfs_months) & !is.na(merged_df$dfs_event)
rsf_data <- merged_df[survival_complete, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event", leiden_cols_filtered)]

cat("rsf_data rows:", nrow(rsf_data), "\n")
cat("rsf_fit n:    ", rsf_fit$n, "\n")

# ── Build survival_df with in-bag risk score (inference goal: stratify cohort) 
survival_df          <- as.data.frame(rsf_data)
survival_df$rsf_risk <- predict(rsf_fit, newdata = rsf_data)$predicted

# ── Justify number of groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
logrank_results <- sapply(2:5, function(k) {
  tmp <- data.frame(dfs_months = survival_df$dfs_months,
                    dfs_event  = survival_df$dfs_event,
                    grp        = factor(ntile(survival_df$rsf_risk, k)))
  survdiff(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ grp, data = tmp)$chisq
})
names(logrank_results) <- paste0(2:5, " groups")
print(round(logrank_results, 3))

cox2 <- coxph(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ ntile(rsf_risk, 2), data = survival_df)
cox3 <- coxph(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ ntile(rsf_risk, 3), data = survival_df)
cox4 <- coxph(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ ntile(rsf_risk, 4), data = survival_df)
print(AIC(cox2, cox3, cox4))
anova(cox2, cox3, test = "Chisq")
anova(cox3, cox4, test = "Chisq")

# ── Create risk groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Find optimal cutpoints for up to 3 groups
cut_res <- surv_cutpoint(survival_df,
                         time      = "dfs_months",
                         event     = "dfs_event",
                         variables = "rsf_risk",
                         minprop   = 0.15)   # ensures no group < 15% of patients
summary(cut_res)
plot(cut_res, "rsf_risk")  
table(surv_categorize(cut_res)$rsf_risk)

# ── Step 1: categorise patients using the optimal cutpoint ────────────────────
categorized        <- surv_categorize(cut_res)
survival_df$risk_grp <- factor(categorized$rsf_risk,
                                levels = c("low", "high"),
                                labels = c("Low", "High"))

# ── Step 2: confirm unequal groups ───────────────────────────────────────────
table(survival_df$risk_grp)   # should NOT be equal

saveRDS(survival_df, "survival_df_with_risk.rds")
survival_df <-readRDS("survival_df_with_risk.rds")

# ── Step 3: re-fit KM with new groups ────────────────────────────────────────
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp, data = survival_df)

# ── Step 4: plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsurvplot(km_fit, data = survival_df,
           pval         = TRUE,
           pval.method  = TRUE,
           pval.size =3,
           risk.table   = TRUE,
           conf.int     = FALSE,
           palette      = c("#4DAF6E", "#C0392B"),
           legend.labs  = c("Low", "High"),
           legend.title = "Risk Group",
           xlab         = "Time (months)",
           ylab         = "Disease-Free Survival Probability",
           title        = "DFS: RSF-Derived Risk Groups",
           risk.table.height = 0.25,
           ggtheme      = theme_minimal())
```

```{r}
##CRPS value and plot#
# ── Get Brier scores for KM and RSF censoring models ─────────────────────────
bs_km  <- get.brier.survival(rsf_fit_final, cens.mode = "km")$brier.score
bs_rsf <- get.brier.survival(rsf_fit_final, cens.mode = "rfsrc")$brier.score

# Use each model's own time column directly
time_km  <- bs_km[, 1]
time_rsf <- bs_rsf[, 1]

cat("KM time range: ",  round(range(time_km),  1), "\n")
cat("RSF time range:", round(range(time_rsf), 1), "\n")

# ── Calculate CRPS at every time point ───────────────────────────────────────
trapz <- randomForestSRC:::trapz

crps_km  <- sapply(2:nrow(bs_km), function(j) {
  trapz(time_km[1:j],  bs_km[1:j,  2] / diff(range(time_km[1:j])))
})
crps_rsf <- sapply(2:nrow(bs_rsf), function(j) {
  trapz(time_rsf[1:j], bs_rsf[1:j, 2] / diff(range(time_rsf[1:j])))
})

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot(time_km[-1],  crps_km,
     type = "s", col = "#D95F02", lwd = 2,
     ylab = "CRPS", xlab = "Time (months)",
     main = "CRPS: RSF vs Null (KM) Model",
     ylim = range(c(crps_km, crps_rsf)))
lines(time_rsf[-1], crps_rsf,
      type = "s", col = "#1B9E77", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Null (KM)", "RSF"),
       col    = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 2)
```





```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# === SURVIVAL + BRIER SCORE PLOTS (CAPPED AT 120 MONTHS) ===
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

MAX_TIME <- 120

# ── 1. KM survival plot (correct risk groups, capped at 120) ──
km_fit_cap <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp, 
                      data = survival_df)

p1 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_cap, data = survival_df,
           xlim             = c(0, MAX_TIME),
           break.time.by    = 20,
           pval             = TRUE,
           pval.method      = TRUE,
           pval.size        = 3,
           risk.table       = TRUE,
           conf.int         = FALSE,
           palette          = c("#1B9E77", "#E7298A"),
           legend.labs      = c("Low", "High"),
           legend.title     = "Risk Group",
           xlab             = "Time (months)",
           ylab             = "Disease-Free Survival Probability",
           title            = "DFS: RSF-Derived Risk Groups (capped at 120 months)",
           risk.table.height = 0.25,
           ggtheme          = theme_minimal())
print(p1)

# ── 2. Brier score plot (ggplot2 to avoid device conflict) ─


bs_km  <- get.brier.survival(rsf_fit_final, cens.mode = "km")
bs_rsf <- get.brier.survival(rsf_fit_final, cens.mode = "rfsrc")

bs_km_df  <- as.data.frame(bs_km$brier.score)
bs_rsf_df <- as.data.frame(bs_rsf$brier.score)

bs_km_cap  <- bs_km_df[bs_km_df[, 1]  <= MAX_TIME, ]
bs_rsf_cap <- bs_rsf_df[bs_rsf_df[, 1] <= MAX_TIME, ]

brier_plot_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(time = bs_km_cap[, 1],  brier = bs_km_cap[, 2],  model = "KM (null)"),
  data.frame(time = bs_rsf_cap[, 1], brier = bs_rsf_cap[, 2], model = "RSF")
)

ggplot(brier_plot_df, aes(x = time, y = brier, colour = model)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = MAX_TIME * 0.7, y = 0.255,
           label = "Random guessing (0.25)", colour = "grey40", size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("KM (null)" = "#E7298A", "RSF" = "#1B9E77")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, MAX_TIME), breaks = seq(0, MAX_TIME, 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Time (months)", y = "Brier Score",
       title = "Brier Score: RSF vs Null KM (capped at 120 months)",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
cent_long <- centroids %>%
  mutate(profile_group = paste0("Group", 1:2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = leiden_cols,
               names_to = "leiden_cluster",
               values_to = "mean_prob")

# Keep only clusters where at least one group has mean_prob > threshold
top_clusters <- cent_long %>%
  group_by(leiden_cluster) %>%
  summarise(max_prob = max(mean_prob)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_prob)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(leiden_cluster)

cent_long %>%
  filter(leiden_cluster %in% top_clusters) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = leiden_cluster, y = profile_group, fill = mean_prob)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_prob, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2E9FDF") +
  labs(title = "Top clusters by profile group",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Profile Group", fill = "Mean Prob") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

diff_df <- data.frame(
  leiden_cluster = leiden_cols,
  group1_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[1, ]),
  group2_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[2, ])
)

diff_df$difference <- abs(diff_df$group1_prob - diff_df$group2_prob)

# Top discriminating clusters
diff_df %>%
  arrange(desc(difference)) %>%
  head(15)
```

```{r}
# All event / no-event MCs must be columns in merged_df
stopifnot(all(mc_event_both    %in% colnames(merged_df)))
stopifnot(all(mc_no_event_both %in% colnames(merged_df)))
merged_df_scores <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    # summed abundance over bad (event) metaclusters
    bad_abund  = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_event_both)),    na.rm = TRUE),
    # summed abundance over good (no-event) metaclusters
    good_abund = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_no_event_both)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # raw score: higher = more bad vs good
    score_raw = bad_abund - good_abund
  )

ggplot(merged_df_scores, aes(x = score_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Raw prognosis score (bad - good MC abundance)",
    y = "Number of patients"
  )

```

```{r}
# use the leiden abundance cols as predictors
leiden_cols_new <- colnames(merged_relapse)[grepl("abundance_metacluster_leiden", colnames(merged_relapse))]
X <- as.matrix(merged_relapse[, leiden_cols_new])
y <- merged_relapse$dfs_event

# LASSO logistic regression
fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds =5)

# plot cross-validation curve
plot(fit)

# coefficients at best lambda
coef(fit, s = "lambda.min")

# non-zero predictors only
coef_mat <- coef(fit, s = "lambda.min")
coef_mat[coef_mat[,1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# does MC_80 abundance perfectly separate relapse groups?
merged_relapse %>%
  select(dfs_event, abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80) %>%
  group_by(dfs_event) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80),
            sd   = sd(abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80))
```
```{r}
# extract non-zero coefficients
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = rownames(coef_mat),
  coefficient = coef_mat[, 1]
) %>%
  filter(cluster != "(Intercept)", coefficient != 0)

# split into > 0 (associated with relapse) and < 0 (protective)
relapse_associated <- coef_df %>% filter(coefficient > 0) %>% arrange(desc(coefficient))
protective         <- coef_df %>% filter(coefficient < 0) %>% arrange(coefficient)

cat("=== Associated with RELAPSE (coef > 0) ===\n")
print(relapse_associated)

cat("\n=== PROTECTIVE against relapse (coef < 0) ===\n")
print(protective)
```
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
# LASSO selected clusters
lasso_clusters <- c(
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_15",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_52",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_0",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_8",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_35",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_13",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_7",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_11",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_12"
)

heatmap_data <- merged_relapse %>%
  filter(!is.na(dfs_event)) %>%
  group_by(dfs_event) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(lasso_clusters), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("dfs_event") %>%
  t()

rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_", "", rownames(heatmap_data))
colnames(heatmap_data) <- c("No Relapse", "Relapse")

# remove zero variance rows
heatmap_data_clean <- heatmap_data[apply(heatmap_data, 1, sd) != 0, ]

pheatmap(heatmap_data_clean,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         main = "LASSO-selected Metacluster Abundance by Relapse Status",
         fontsize_row = 10)


mc_prob_stats_lasso <- map_dfr(lasso_clusters, function(col) {
  p <- merged_relapse[[col]]

  p_event   <- p[merged_relapse$dfs_event == 1]
  p_noevent <- p[merged_relapse$dfs_event == 0]

  p_event   <- p_event[!is.na(p_event)]
  p_noevent <- p_noevent[!is.na(p_noevent)]

  wt <- wilcox.test(p_event, p_noevent, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    metacluster         = gsub("abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_", "", col),
    mean_relapse        = mean(p_event),
    mean_no_relapse     = mean(p_noevent),
    p_value             = wt$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(adj_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

print(mc_prob_stats_lasso, n = Inf)
```
